payout_quote: Official Wyzant support: 'All tutors will retain 75% of their posted hourly rate for lessons with students, minus any applicable taxes, and Wyzant will retain a 25% Platform Fee.'
steps: Create a Wyzant tutor profile and list your subjects with your posted hourly rate.
Agree to the Independent Tutor Agreement; pass Wyzant's tutor approval process.
Get matched with students; conduct lessons (online or in-person).
Wyzant processes payment; you retain 75% of your posted rate per lesson.
catches: Wyzant retains a 25% Platform Fee from every lesson — you keep 75% of your posted rate.
You set your posted rate, so earnings are variable with no guaranteed hours or students.
All lessons are subject to a 9% service fee (per the fee article) plus applicable taxes.
You are an independent tutor; no benefits; must pass Wyzant's approval.
biggest_catch: You keep only 75% of your posted rate (25% platform fee), and there are no guaranteed hours — earnings depend on setting a competitive rate and winning students.
eligibility: 18+; subject expertise; pass Wyzant tutor application and agree to the Independent Tutor Agreement.
timing: Paid per lesson via Wyzant after each completed lesson.
